title: Siman 286
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.en: (46.) He said: "I have already wondered at the world — wherever there is found some genuine goodness, it is fitting that it draw close to us" [in Yiddish: "vi se gefint zich eppes rechts iz mechuyev tsu mir mekurev tsu vern"].
